items.raw_excerpt: Older Tasmanians and those least familiar with digital services will likely be impacted by a state government proposal to reduce the contact hours at five regional Service Tasmania centres, a mayor says.
items.summary_en: A mayor says a state government plan to reduce the contact hours of five regional Service Tasmania centres will hurt older residents. These older Tasmanians are less familiar with digital services. The change could widen the digital divide in those communities.
items.summary_ko: 한 시장은 지역 서비스센터 5곳의 방문 문의 시간을 줄이려는 주정부 계획이 노인들에게 타격이 될 것이라고 말했습니다. 디지털 서비스에 익숙하지 않은 노인들이 가장 큰 영향을 받을 것으로 보입니다. 이번 변화가 지역 사회의 디지털 격차를 더 키울 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Tasmania plans to cut opening hours at five service centres
items.title_ko: 태즈메이니아 서비스센터 5곳, 문의 가능 시간 줄어든다
items.title_original: Service Tasmania contact centre cuts will fuel digital divide, MP says

items.raw_excerpt: Maharashtra's anti-superstition group challenges government's decision to install astrological time devices, urging adherence to scientific principles.
items.summary_en: A group that fights superstition wants Maharashtra state to cancel its plan to install astrological time devices. The group says the state should follow science and not astrology.
items.summary_ko: 인도의 미신 반대 단체가 마하라슈트라 주정부의 점성술 시간 장치 설치 결정을 취소해 달라고 요구했다. 이 단체는 점성술 대신 과학 원칙을 따라야 한다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Anti-superstition group asks Maharashtra to cancel astrological time devices
items.title_ko: 미신 반대 단체, 마하라슈트라 주정부 점성술 시간 장치 설치에 반발
items.title_original: Anti-superstition body seeks revocation of Maharashtra govt decision to install astrological time devices in State HQ

items.raw_excerpt: A floating garden of native plants in Victoria's east cuts a wastewater lagoon's emissions by about 30 per cent, with researchers now testing the approach on farm dams.
items.summary_en: A floating garden made of native plants is reducing greenhouse gas emissions from a wastewater lagoon in Victoria by about 30 percent. Researchers are now testing the same approach on farm dams. The garden is one of the first of its kind in the world.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주 동부에서 자생 식물로 만든 수상 정원이 하수 처리장 연못의 온실가스 배출을 약 30퍼센트 줄였다. 연구진은 이 방식을 농장 저수지에도 적용하는 방안을 시험하고 있다. 이 정원은 세계에서 처음 선보인 방식 중 하나다.
items.title_en: Floating gardens cut wastewater gases in a world-first trial
items.title_ko: 수상 정원이 하수 연못의 온실가스를 줄인 세계 첫 실험
items.title_original: World-first trial finds floating wetlands can cut greenhouse gas emissions

items.raw_excerpt: Kirsty Priest says she remains strong or she would feel sorry for herself, after her third diagnosis.
items.summary_en: Kirsty Priest has been diagnosed with cancer three times. She says she stays strong, or she would feel sorry for herself. The grandmother keeps a positive outlook after her third diagnosis.
items.summary_ko: 커스티 프리스트 씨는 암 진단을 세 번 받았습니다. 그녀는 자신이 강하게 버티고 있으며 그래야 스스로 불쌍하다고 느끼지 않을 거라고 말합니다. 세 번째 진단 이후에도 이 할머니는 긍정적인 마음을 유지하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Grandmother stays positive despite three cancer battles
items.title_ko: 암 세 번 이겨낸 할머니, 긍정 마음 잃지 않아
items.title_original: How one grandmother stays positive despite three bouts of cancer

items.summary_en: On September 11, people from many communities met to discuss city planning near the Red River. They asked the city to move traffic routes away from homes, stop tearing down old villages, and keep the existing cemeteries.
items.summary_ko: 9월 11일 붉은 강변 도시계획 회의에서 여러 지역 주민 대표들은 교통 도로를 주거지에서 멀리 옮겨 달라고 요청했습니다. 또한 옛 마을 철거를 제한하고 기존 묘지를 보존해 달라고 요구했습니다.
items.title_en: Hanoi residents ask to keep roads away from old villages
items.title_ko: 하노이 주민들, 옛 마을을 지키는 도로 개선 요구

items.raw_excerpt: The Local's Becky Waterton was one of the lucky ones to get her Swedish citizenship just before the law changed. Here she reflects on what that means to her, and shares the top stories of the week.
items.summary_en: Becky Waterton from The Local got her Swedish citizenship just before the law changed. She reflects on how voting for the first time made her feel truly Swedish. She also shares the top stories of the week.
items.summary_ko: 더 로컬의 베키 워터튼은 법이 바뀌기 직전에 스웨덴 시민권을 받았다. 처음으로 투표를 한 것이 마침내 스웨덴 사람처럼 느끼게 해줬다고 회상한다. 이번 주 주요 기사도 함께 전한다.
items.title_en: Inside Sweden: Voting for the first time was what made me finally feel Swedish
items.title_ko: 스웨덴 속으로: 처음 투표가 마침내 스웨덴 사람처럼 느끼게 해줬다
items.title_original: Inside Sweden: Voting for the first time was what made me finally feel Swedish

items.raw_excerpt: In this week's Inside Spain, we explore why textbooks and other school materials are so eye-wateringly expensive in a country reputed for its low salaries.
items.summary_en: Spain has the most expensive school textbooks in Europe. A parent shares how his three-year-old's schoolbooks cost about 250 euros for the year. Frequent education law changes and regional rules push prices up.
items.summary_ko: 스페인은 유럽에서 교과서가 가장 비싼 나라입니다. 한 부모는 세 살 아이의 한 해 교과서값이 250유로였다고 전합니다. 자주 바뀌는 교육법과 지역별 규칙 때문에 가격이 오릅니다.
items.title_en: Why do my three-year-old's schoolbooks cost 250 euros?
items.title_ko: 우리 아이 세 살 교과서가 왜 250유로일까
items.title_original: Inside Spain: Why do my three-year-old's schoolbooks cost €250?

items.raw_excerpt: More than two-thirds of middle-aged adults are delaying their eye tests despite having problems.
items.summary_en: A survey says more than two-thirds of middle-aged adults put off eye tests even when they have vision problems. They delay the checkup for a long time or avoid it completely.
items.summary_ko: 조사에 따르면 중년 성인 3분의 2 이상이 눈 문제가 있음에도 눈 검진을 미루고 있습니다. 그들은 눈 검진을 오랫동안 미루거나 아예 피하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Survey finds middle-aged adults delay eye tests despite problems
items.title_ko: 조사에 따르면 중년 성인들은 눈 검진을 미루고 있다
items.title_original: Two-thirds of middle-aged adults delay eye tests despite problems - survey

items.raw_excerpt: Established by Vökufélagið, an association promoting folk arts activities in Iceland, Vaka Festival is a great opportunity to discover the traditional music of the island and its neighbouring countries. This playlist offers a musical introduction to the festival that brings together traditional sounds from Iceland, Norway, and Poland, with fresh interpretations of folk music and…
items.summary_en: An association that promotes folk arts in Iceland founded the Vaka Festival. The festival is a good place to discover traditional music of Iceland and nearby countries. This playlist brings folk sounds from Iceland, Norway, and Poland with fresh new versions.

items.raw_excerpt: Ireland’s Blarney Castle has been named one of the world’s ten luckiest destinations, placing eighth in a new international ranking.
items.summary_en: Ireland's Blarney Castle was named one of the world's ten luckiest destinations. It placed eighth in a new international ranking. The famous castle is known for its Blarney Stone.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드의 블라니 성이 세계에서 가장 운이 좋은 여행지 10곳 중 하나로 선정됐다. 새 국제 순위에서 8위를 차지했다. 이 유명한 성은 블라니 스톤으로 잘 알려져 있다.
items.title_en: Irish castle ranks 8th among luckiest places in the world

items.title_original: Irish castle earns global recognition

items.raw_excerpt: Apple's latest iPhones -- the iPhone 18 Pro series and the iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone -- sold out within two minutes of preorders opening Thursday afternoon, Chunghwa Telecom Co., one of Taiwan's major telecom operators, said late Friday night.
items.summary_en: Apple's latest iPhones, including the iPhone 18 Pro series and the iPhone Duo, sold out two minutes after preorders opened on Thursday afternoon. Chunghwa Telecom, a major Taiwan telecom operator, made the announcement late Friday night.
items.summary_ko: 애플의 최신 아이폰인 아이폰 18 프로 시리즈와 첫 폴더블 아이폰인 아이폰 듀오가 목요일 오후 판매 시작 2분 만에 매진됐다. 대만의 주요 통신사인 중화텔레콤이 금요일 늦은 밤 이 소식을 전했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Bangchak Group said no leaks were found in a fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Klong Toey district of Bangkok following an inspection after thousands of litres of oil-contaminated wastewater were reported in the area.
items.summary_en: Bangchak Group inspected a fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Klong Toey district of Bangkok. Thousands of litres of oil-contaminated wastewater were reported in the area. The company says the check found no leaks in the pipeline.
items.summary_ko: 방착 그룹이 방콕 끌롱또이 지역 추아 프렁 로드의 연료 배관을 점검했다. 인근에서 수천 리터의 기름 오염 폐수가 신고된 바 있다. 회사는 점검 결과 배관에서 누유가 발견되지 않았다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Bangchak finds no leaks in Bangkok fuel pipeline
items.title_ko: 방콕 연료 배관에서 누유 없음, 방착 확인
items.title_original: Bangchak says no leaks found in Bangkok fuel pipeline

items.raw_excerpt: After a string of failed ventures, Ngo Huynh Trang went home and put all her money into turning 6 hectares of family forest into an eco-tourism site on the edge of a UNESCO biosphere reserve.
items.summary_en: A woman went home after several failed business attempts. She put all her money into turning six hectares of family forest into an eco-tourism site. The site sits next to a UNESCO biosphere reserve.
items.summary_ko: 여러 번 사업에 실패한 뒤 고향으로 돌아온 여성이 가족의 숲 6헥타르에 돈을 모두 쏟아부었습니다. 그 숲을 유네스코 생물권 보전 지역 가장자리에 있는 생태 관광지로 만들었습니다.
items.title_en: Woman leaves city job to turn family forest into eco-tourism site
items.title_ko: 도시 생활을 버리고 가족의 숲을 생태 관광지로 만든 여성
items.title_original: Woman abandons city career to turn 6 hectares of family forest into $380,000-a-year business

items.raw_excerpt: The annual Zulu reed dance is underway at eMashobeni Royal Palace, KZN.
items.summary_en: The Zulu reed dance festival has started at eMashobeni Royal Palace in KwaZulu-Natal. Thousands of young women join the traditional ceremony. The event celebrates Zulu culture and heritage.

items.title_original: LIVE | Annual Zulu Reed Dance

items.raw_excerpt: Icelandair mechanics are voting on an indefinite strike. The airline warns a walkout could quickly disrupt its September flight schedule.
items.summary_en: Icelandair mechanics are voting on whether to go on an indefinite strike. The airline warns that a walkout could quickly disrupt its September flight schedule.

items.raw_excerpt: There are around 5,000 restaurants in the Algarve. That sounds wonderful, but perhaps it is too many.
items.summary_en: There are about 5,000 restaurants in the Algarve region of Portugal. That sounds great, but it may be too many. A shake-out in the restaurant business is coming.

items.raw_excerpt: This follows the National Lotteries Commission's funding of a private clinic in Dihatswane village
items.summary_en: The North West health department welcomed 3.9 million rand from the National Lotteries Commission. The money will fund a rural clinic in Mahikeng, including a clinic in Dihatswane village. It is the first time lottery money has paid for clinics this way.
items.summary_ko: 노스웨스트 보건국이 국립복권위원회의 390만 랜드 지원을 환영했다. 이 돈은 마히켕의 시골 진료소에 쓰이며, 디하츠와네 마을의 진료소도 지원 대상에 포함된다. 복권 기금이 이런 방식으로 진료소를 지원한 것은 이번이 처음이다.

items.raw_excerpt: This French term isn't just one for history classes, it has a modern usage as well.
items.summary_en: Le dauphin is a French word with two meanings. It can mean dolphin or the crown prince, heir to the throne. It is not just a history word, it is still used today.
items.summary_ko: 르 도팽은 프랑스어 단어로 두 가지 뜻이 있습니다. 돌고래 또는 왕세자, 왕위 계승자를 뜻합니다. 역사 수업에서만 쓰는 단어가 아니라 오늘날에도 여전히 쓰입니다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Le dauphin
items.title_ko: 오늘의 프랑스어 단어: 르 도팽

items.raw_excerpt: Water chestnut, an invasive aquatic species, multiplies quickly and blocks the light other species rely on. The watershed council for the Vaudreuil-Soulanges area is working to eradicate it from the Ottawa River and the Lake of Two Mountains.
items.summary_en: Water chestnut is an invasive water plant that grows fast and blocks sunlight other species need. Biologists in Quebec are removing it by hand from the Ottawa River and the Lake of Two Mountains.
items.summary_ko: 마름은 침입 수생 식물로 빠르게 번식해 다른 생물이 필요한 햇빛을 가린다. 퀘벡 주 생물학자들은 오타와 강과 투 마운틴 호수에서 이 식물을 손으로 제거하고 있다.
items.title_en: Biologists are fighting this invasive plant by hand to protect some Quebec waters
items.title_ko: 생물학자들이 퀘벡의 물을 지키려 침입 식물을 손으로 뽑아내고 있다
items.title_original: Biologists are fighting this invasive plant – by hand – to protect some Quebec waters

items.raw_excerpt: Autumn is all about an atmospheric interior, tactile textures and layered lighting with longer nights, says Sam Wylie-Harris.
items.summary_en: An interior expert explains how to decorate for autumn. She suggests warm textures and layered lighting for longer nights. The goal is to create a cosy atmosphere in your home.
items.summary_ko: 인테리어 전문가가 가을에 맞는 집 꾸미기 방법을 알려줍니다. 긴 밤을 위해 따뜻한 질감과 층을 이루는 조명을 활용하라고 조언합니다. 집 안에 포근한 분위기를 만드는 것이 목표입니다.
